claims.text: The driver never entered the pickup geofence. All 25 driver fixes in EV-GPS-00854 sit at 200.1508679602189 m from the pickup pin - min, mean and max identical - and the arrival analysis records qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 120 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 fixes for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, which is the zone class EV-TRIP-00854 records for this Suntec City Tower 3 booking. With not one qualifying in-radius fix, no admissible arrival exists under POL-NS-02.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the driver fails it twice. Limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the geofence at or before the arrival event; the track places him 200 m outside that radius throughout, so limb (b) fails. Limb (c) requires a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force - 180 seconds, read from EV-TRIP-00854.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - and the clause measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap; there are zero in-geofence fixes, so the dwell is 0 seconds and limb (c) fails as well. Breaking any single limb is enough, and here two of the four are broken: the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

This is the POL-NS-03 case, and POL-NS-03 is decided from coordinates alone. The driver's own trace shows him stationary - distinct_speeds_kph of [0] - from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00, 240 seconds, comfortably the required dwell, at a point 200.15 m from the pickup pin: outside the 120 m arrival radius but far inside the clause's 400 m ceiling, measured from trip_record.pickup. On those facts the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

Any payment to the driver here is platform-funded and cannot be netted against the rider's refund. POL-NS-03(ii) applies: neither party named a sub-location in EV-CHAT-00854 - the whole exchange is 'I am here.', 'I am here too.', 'I still cannot see you.' - and EV-TRIP-00854.registered_pickup_points is 3, so the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver's remedy is a goodwill payment of 50 percent of the cancellation fee charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. Under POL-GEN-03 that payment and the rider's refund are independent and are never netted, so the rider's refund of the full 4.50 charged (EV-FARE-00854.total_charged, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0) is whole.

Independently of where the driver stopped, the waiting period was never served. The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip, a shortfall of 180.0 seconds on the trace's own arithmetic. POL-NS-06 applies on its own terms: the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered the driver's messages.

That shortfall cannot be closed by accumulation. POL-NS-06(i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory covering the pickup road and the waiting window is present and populated with an admissible type such as KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. No advisory exists for this trip: EV-ADVIS-00854-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and carries weight 0.0. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable on this record and the 180 second shortfall stands.

I do not overreach on the arrival marker. At the 18:10:00 arrival tap the driver was stationary at 200.15 m from the pin - inside POL-NS-05's 300 m trigger and at 0 km/h, well under its 15 km/h trigger - so the marker is not FALSE and POL-NS-05 is expressly not the rider's route here: the clause itself sends a driver who is stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03. What the marker cannot do is start a waiting clock that counts, because POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and there are none.

The driver cannot shelter behind the arrival tap. EV-TRIP-00854.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 - which treats the platform's arrival and wait-timer telemetry as a carrier independent of the exported trace - does not apply to this trip. The pressed marker must therefore satisfy POL-NS-02's geofence test on the trace itself, and on the trace it fails.

The rider was at the pickup. rider_track is available in EV-GPS-00854 with 25 fixes, all 25 qualifying, and min, mean and max distance of 0.0 m - well inside the 150 m rider presence radius for LARGE_VENUE - and derived.arrival records rider_qualifying_fix_count of 25. That test, POL-NS-04(c), is satisfied on the numbers, and limb (a) is at least arguable on 'I am here too.' sent at 18:10:30. I do not put POL-NS-04 forward as the deciding clause, and I say so plainly: limb (b) fails, because the driver replied in EV-CHAT-00854 at 18:10:40, ten seconds after that message, so the clause exonerates nobody on this record. The presence evidence still matters, because the platform's own rider track contradicts the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code recorded in EV-TRIP-00854.

No driver compensation is payable out of the rider's money. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'; POL-NS-01 fails on limbs (b) and (c), and POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 both displace it, so the compensation route is closed and the 4.50 the rider paid cannot be retained as the driver's payout. For completeness, the anti-farming counters give no independent support either: EV-DPROF-00854 shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 over completed_trips_30d of 100, below both limbs of the POL-NS-07 check.

No limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged, so this case can and should be decided by a monetary ruling rather than sent to human review. Nothing contradicts the trace on arrival, dwell or rider presence - the arrival tap and the 200 m fix are reconciled by POL-NS-03 rather than left in conflict. EV-RPROF-00854 and EV-DPROF-00854 both record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 for this rider-and-driver pair. EV-RPROF-00854.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; its prior_no_show_flags of 1 is the lifetime counter, which POL-NS-09(d) does not read and which may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day figure. No evidence for the deciding fact is impaired: every artifact in the bundle carries weight 1.0 except the missing advisory, which no deciding fact rests on.

The rider's case rests on clean evidence, so the 200 m finding carries full weight. EV-GPS-00854 has 100 percent coverage, 25 fixes at the 10 second sample interval with no gaps, and a first fix at 18:10:00 matching the trip record's arrival event to the second - zero clock skew against POL-NS-08(a)'s 90 second threshold. The chat log is complete at 3 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count 3 with consecutive msg_ids, and EV-FARE-00854's cancellation_fee line of 4.50 reconciles with the 4.50 net figure in platform_policy, satisfying POL-NS-08(d). There is no impairment under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) and so nothing to discount under POL-GEN-02(2).

claims.text: The driver was on station at the Suntec City pickup for the whole waiting window and beyond: his trace runs from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 across 25 fixes, the distance to the pickup pin is constant at 200.15 m (min = max = mean) and the only speed recorded is 0 kph, so he held position for a continuous 240 seconds - 60 seconds longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. He did not cut and run; he waited out the clock and then some.

The sum charged is the published figure, not a bookkeeping artefact: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is SGD 4.50 and it reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, with the derived money block reporting a difference of 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect for the rider to exploit.

The arrival marker is not false and the waiting clock was not reset. At the 18:10:00 arrival event the driver's fixes place him 200.15 m from the pin - inside the 300 m marker threshold of POL-NS-05 - and his recorded speed is 0 kph, far below the 15 kph motion trigger. Both independent triggers of POL-NS-05 therefore fail, the arrival marker stands, and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list against this driver.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04: limb (b) fails outright on the chat log. The rider's only message is at 18:10:30 and the driver replied at 18:10:40, ten seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, after having messaged first at 18:10:10; there was no silence to hold against the driver. Limb (a) is also doubtful, since 'I am here too.' names no position, entrance, block, tower or bay and asks for nothing - it is an assertion of presence, not a locating or coordinating message.

I concede the fee cannot be carried under POL-NS-01 itself. The driver's own trace places every one of his 25 fixes roughly 200 m from the pickup pin and records 0 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is not made out on this record and the cancellation fee is not chargeable as a baseline no-show.

That concession does not dispose of the case: these are precisely the facts POL-NS-03 was written for. The driver's stationary fixes lie outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius but only 200.15 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 400 m ceiling, and he held that position for a continuous 240 seconds - more than the required dwell of 180 seconds. POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03 on such facts by its own terms, and POL-NS-03 governs the outcome including the driver's compensation.

The fault on these facts is pin ambiguity, not driver failure, and POL-NS-03(ii) therefore pays the driver. Neither party specified a sub-location in the chat (the rider said only 'I am here too.'), and the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 3, well above the threshold of 2. The driver is accordingly entitled to the platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, that is SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.

POL-NS-03(i) does not strip that goodwill. Limb (i) bites only where the rider stated the correct entrance, block or tower in the chat log and the driver failed to move to it; the rider's messages here are 'I am here too.' at 18:10:30 and nothing more, with no entrance, block, tower or bay ever named. The driver cannot be said to have ignored a sub-location the rider never gave.

There is no anti-farming reason to withhold the driver's payment. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and that figure divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01, below the 0.08 rate. Both limbs of the POL-NS-07 check must trip and neither does, so compensation is not withheld and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged on this driver.

No other escalation trigger exists and this case should be decided on the record rather than parked in human review. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) cannot fire; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) cannot fire on the rider side; and no POL-NS-08 impairment is present - the trace carries 25 fixes at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec of 10 and full coverage, and the trip record's arrival event at 18:10:00 coincides with the first GPS fix, so there is no clock skew under limb (a) and no trace gap under limb (b). All artifacts relied on are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor.

POL-NS-06's shortfall rule is not the operative clause on this record and cannot be used to strip the POL-NS-03 goodwill. That clause measures the effective IN-GEOFENCE dwell computed under POL-NS-02; this driver never entered the geofence at all, and POL-NS-02's own carve-out sends a driver who held position outside the radius but within 400 m to POL-NS-03, which decides the outcome including his compensation. A driver who waited the full period at the wrong face of a venue does not lose the pin-ambiguity payment because he was on the wrong side of the radius line.

I do not assert POL-NS-06(i) and I disclose the reason: EV-ADVIS-00854-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, so no traffic advisory is on file, the accumulation limb is unavailable, and nothing may be asserted against that absent artifact. The driver's 240-second dwell was a single uninterrupted interval in any event, so he needs no accumulation and rests no part of his case on the missing advisory.

Both independent triggers of POL-NS-05 therefore fail, the arrival marker stands, and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list against this driver.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04: limb (b) fails outright on the chat log. The rider's only message is at 18:10:30 and the driver replied at 18:10:40, ten seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, after having messaged first at 18:10:10; there was no silence to hold against the driver. That concession does not dispose of the case: these are precisely the facts POL-NS-03 was written for. The driver's stationary fixes lie outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius but only 200.15 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 400 m ceiling, and he held that position for a continuous 240 seconds - more than the required dwell of 180 seconds. POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03 on such facts by its own terms, and POL-NS-03 governs the outcome including the driver's compensation.

The fault on these facts is pin ambiguity, not driver failure, and POL-NS-03(ii) therefore pays the driver. Neither party specified a sub-location in the chat (the rider said only 'I am here too.'), and the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 3, well above the threshold of 2. The driver is accordingly entitled to the platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, that is SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.
